summary: Replays a notebook's logged prompts through kbSearch and diffs two builds, so a recall change can be measured on a notebook that is NOT this repo's — the reason it exists is that coldstart's own notebook is ~44 notes about coldstart, where the junk cause the gates target barely occurs. Used by humans only: nothing imports it, it is invoked as `node scripts/replay-recall-gates.mjs --root <repo> --dist <coldstart>/dist [--mode hook|tool] [--out f.json]`, then `--compare before.json after.json`. Its reason for printing the options it used is a real incident: KbSearchOptions has NO `hook` field, so {hook:true} silently runs TOOL mode with convergence off, which voided an entire measurement — the header line is the assertion that the run is the mode you think. `--mode tool` exists because every admission gate in kbSearch is wrapped in `if (opts.strongOnly)` while the fold runs upstream of both modes, so an alias-side change can move `kb search` results while looking invisible in hook mode. Read-only on the target repo: it passes noMissLog so the replay does not pollute that repo's metrics.
